tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Search BOP's listed businesses by keyword (business name, city or district, or type of class) and/or category. Returns up to 10 businesses with a few matching services. Read-only.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Get one business's public profile (city, address, hours, booking and cancellation policy, contact, FAQ) and its active services with prices, durations and weekly schedules. Read-only.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: List open time slots (Asia/Taipei) for one service in the next 1–14 days, with remaining capacity. Use the returned slot value as-is in request_booking. Read-only.

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Create a booking for one open slot on behalf of the customer, after the customer has agreed to the service, time, quantity and contact details. tools.name: modify_booking
tools.description: Change the slot or quantity of a pending, awaiting_payment or confirmed booking, when the customer asks to. Replaces the booking's time or quantity and frees the old place. tools.name: get_booking_status
tools.description: Get the current status of a booking made with request_booking (confirmed, waiting for the business, awaiting online payment, declined, or cancelled), including payment and refund details. Read-only.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a confirmed, pending or awaiting_payment booking made with request_booking, when the customer asks to. tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: For businesses whose booking_mode is external_link: get a link to the business's own booking page for one service. The click is counted for the business. Booking and payment happen on that page.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_booking · Private data: get_business, request_booking, complete_booking · Public sink: request_booking · Destructive: modify_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_booking · Private data: get_business, request_booking, complete_booking · Public sink: request_booking · Destructive: modify_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
